source_provenance.file: 燃气动态风险推演_前端示例原型_v1.html
source_provenance.reproducibility_limit: The original sort comparator consumes random numbers and is not a total order. Re-extract only with the pinned runtime; the committed JSON is the portable canonical fixture.
source_provenance.connection_evidence: edges[].a/b and facs[].n / nodes[].hh/com from reviewed source; never inferred from SVG or distances.

extraction_notes: Edge endpoint order is storage order, not upstream/downstream or simulated gas flow direction.
Valves are node cuts. A valve is not a pipe or edge; incident_edge_ids is an explicit incidence list, not one-to-one control ownership.
Facilities at N24 and N45 are retained, although the prototype disconnected() excludes all valve/source nodes from user accounting. The candidate exposes them rather than silently discarding them.
Pressure, flow, leakage, dispersion, ignition, explosion, field valve instruction and safe gas restoration are unsupported.

evolution.source_expression: p12 = 1-exp(-lambda*e.Lkm); label and preset intensity do not establish a calibrated prediction horizon

source_only_formulas.original_VOI: If interval endpoint grades differ, sqrt(upper*Csys)-sqrt(lower*Csys); otherwise 0.
source_only_formulas.use: Preserved labels and arithmetic assumptions only; none evaluated by the gas graph candidate.

prototype_data_available_flags.meaning: UI toggles only, not evidence that any real dataset or professional model was received.
